instructions:
1. Anchor the band low behind you. Stand facing away, a handle in each hand, palms forward.
2. Stagger your stance, one foot forward, both knees slightly bent. Hold your arms down and slightly out to the sides.
3. Sweep both hands up and together in an arc to about chin height, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
4. Lower your arms back to the start with control.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you sweep up, inhale as you lower.
2. Squeeze your upper chest at the top of each rep.
3. Keep your torso upright and core braced, do not lean back.
4. Use a lighter band if your form breaks down.
name: Chest fly low to high Resistance band

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet together, arms out to the sides at shoulder height, elbows bent.
2. Step your right foot out to the side and bend the knee slightly.
3. At the same time, sweep your elbows together in front of your chest.
4. Step back to the start and open your arms wide again.
5. Repeat, alternating sides.
tips:
1. Move slowly and with control.
2. Squeeze your chest as your elbows meet in front.
3. Keep your chest up and core braced during each step.
4. Push through the heel of the stepping foot.
name: Chest fly side step

instructions:
1. Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor. Place your hands behind your head, elbows wide.
2. Brace your core and curl your upper body off the floor.
3. At the top, rotate your torso toward the right.
4. Rotate back to center, then lower your upper body to the floor.
5. Repeat, alternating the rotation side each rep.
tips:
1. Lift with your abs, do not pull on your neck.
2. Keep your elbows wide so your core does the work.
3. Press your lower back into the floor throughout.
4. Exhale as you curl and rotate up.
name: Chest lift with rotation

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, back straight, shoulders relaxed.
2. Interlace your fingers behind your back and straighten your arms.
3. Lift your arms slightly and push your chest forward.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together and hold.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your shoulder blades together to deepen the stretch.
2. Keep your neck relaxed and in line with your spine.
3. Breathe slowly and steadily throughout the hold.
4. Stop if you feel any sharp pain in the shoulders.
name: Chest out hands behind (hold)

instructions:
1. Anchor the band behind you at chest height. Stand facing away, a handle in each hand, palms down.
2. Stagger your stance, one foot forward, both knees slightly bent.
3. Start with your elbows bent and hands at chest level, arms parallel to the floor.
4. Press the handles forward until your arms are fully extended.
5. Return to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you press forward, inhale as you return.
2. Keep your wrists straight and firm.
3. Drive through your chest, not just your arms.
4. Brace your core to stay stable against the band.
name: Chest press front Resistance band
